findings.title: Login predicate NPEs when IDP config is null
findings.body: LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate() now does idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC) without a null check. An IdentityProviderModel with a null config map (possible on create/update representations that set no config) will throw NullPointerException inside registerIDPLoginInvalidation / registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate, breaking create/update/remove. Use a null-safe config lookup.

findings.title: Login cache not invalidated on organization link/unlink or org state change
findings.body: getForLogin() caches ID lists per FetchMode, but invalidation is only registered from IDP create/update/remove. Linking/unlinking an IDP via OrganizationProvider, disabling/enabling/removing an Organization, or changing org membership does not call registerIDPLoginInvalidation, so the cached REALM_ONLY/ORG_ONLY/ALL ID sets become stale (e.g. a realm IDP linked to an org still appears in REALM_ONLY, a private org IDP still appears, or IDPs of a disabled org are still listed).

findings.title: removeAll() and remove/update null paths leave login cache stale or NPE
findings.body: removeAll() only invalidates the count key and never invalidates cacheKeyForLogin keys, so cached getForLogin results survive a bulk delete except by incidental self-heal. Separately, remove() dereferences storedIdp via registerIDPInvalidation() and update() dereferences original.getOrganizationId() without null checks, so removing/updating a non-existent alias/id throws NPE instead of delegating.
